property_summary: For any caller and any nonzero ETH value, calling receive always makes depositsCount become at least 1 (i.e., depositsCount_after >= 1); the mutant forbids any deposit once depositsCount is nonzero, so there exist inputs (a second deposit) where the mutant leaves depositsCount == 1 while the reference would have increased it further (violating the >=1-after-deposit rule when starting from zero and then depositing again).
change_summary: Replace the overflow-checking require with one that always fails when depositsCount is nonzero, preventing increment for any nonzero count.
